Name: Open Hearts
Author: TheOneHermes
Description:
[center][size=4]Introducing [/size][size=6]"Open Hearts"[/size][/center][size=4]

[/size][b][u]Note: Please remember to regularly check for updates to ensure compatibility with future versions of Stardew Valley.This also may break progression and Heart related events/dialogue.Compatibility with other mods is not known.[/u][/b]

[size=5]

Major Features & Changes:
• Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Support:
The mod is now configurable in-game through the Generic Mod Config Menu, making configuration much easier and more friendly.

• Friendship Choice:
New config option for choosing how hearts are applied to NPCs:

• Instant on Save Loaded: Sets all NPCs to max hearts upon loading save.

• Gradual Increase: Friendship points increase by 1 heart per day so that heart events naturally unlock over time.

• Improved HUD Messages:
The mod now displays a thematic HUD message based on your selected mode:

• Gradual mode: "You're a step closer to lifelong friendship!"

• Instant mode: "Friendship increased for all NPCs!"

• Prevents Friendship Decay:
Prevents friendship points from decreasing over time and keeps relationships at their chosen level.[/size][size=4]
[/size]


[size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size]

[size=4]1. Ensure that you have the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿, the indispensable tool for modding Stardew Valley.[/size]

[size=4]2. Download the Open Hearts mod.[/size]

[size=4]3. Locate your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and place the downloaded mod file inside.[/size]

[size=4]4. Launch the game using StardewModdingAPI.exe and prepare to immerse yourself in a world of boundless friendship.[/size]


[b][u]Note: Please remember to regularly check for updates to ensure compatibility with future versions of Stardew Valley.This also may break progression and Heart related events/dialogue.Compatibility with other mods is not known.[/u][/b]
